facts.text: I want to visit some of the best beaches in Sydney, Australia.
I have heard a lot about Bondi Beach.
I will check out Bronte Beach and compare it to Bondi.
I will bring a picnic basket and enjoy the view around Bronte Beach.
I plan to check out Three Blue Ducks for breakfast.
I plan to head to the Bronte Baths for a swim.
